title: Forte

{{Stub}} {{Terminology Infobox |image = Icon Forte.png |type = Game Systems |type2 = Lore |type3 = Combat }} '''Forte''' is the Resonance Abilities that belongs to a resonator. __TOC__ ==Description== The Resonance Abilities of a [[Resonator]] are referred to as their '''Forte'''. In the world of ''Wuthering Waves'' there are as many different Forte's as there are Resonators. It is believed that a Resonator's past and subconscious mind influence their Forte, thus making their Fortes unique. As a part of what seems to be routine health monitoring of Resonators (and as a preventative safety measure) each Resonator goes through an examination and is then written a [[:Category:Character Forte Examination Report|Forte Examination Report]] that provides information on their Forte and status as a Resonator. While Lorewise not all Fortes seem to be suitable for combat, in the [[Combat System]] of ''Wuthering Waves'' a playable Resonator's set of '''Combat Skills''' is synonymous to their Forte. ==Combat Skills== There are six Fortes that all playable Resonators possess: * [[Basic Attack]] * [[Resonance Skill]] * [[Resonance Liberation]] * [[Forte Circuit]] * [[Inherent Skill]] * [[Intro Skill]]/[[Outro Skill]] ---- ===Basic Attack=== [[File:Skill Broadblade.png|50px|right|[[Broadblade]]]] [[File:Skill Gauntlets.png|50px|right|[[Gauntlets]]]] [[File:Skill Pistols.png|50px|right|[[Pistols]]]] [[File:Skill Rectifier.png|50px|right|[[Rectifier]]]] [[File:Skill Sword.png|50px|right|[[Sword]]]] [[Basic Attack]]s refer to Resonators' normal attacks, usually consisting of a repeated combo that deals their respective [[Attribute]]'s DMG. Other than their basic attack combo sequence, there are three other types of attacks that the Basic Attack can deal: *[[Heavy Attack]]: Holding a Basic Attack will consume [[Stamina]] and deal increased [[Attribute]] DMG. *[[Mid-Air Attack]]: Performing a Basic Attack whilst in the air will consume [[Stamina]] to plunge from mid-air and deal increased [[Attribute]] DMG. *[[Dodge Counter]]: After a successful [[Dodge]], performing a [[Basic Attack]] in quick succession will cause a Resonator to perform a Counterattack, dealing increased [[Attribute]] DMG. ''Some Resonators might deviate from this pattern.'' ---- ===Resonance Skill=== [[Resonance Skill]], is a [[Forte]] that regenerates energy for the usage of [[Resonance Liberation]]. The exact details of a Resonance Skill depends on the Resonator. Whilst most Resonance Skills have [[CD]]s, some Resonators' are an exception to this rule and don't have a [[CD]] for their Skills.
''E.g. [[Danjin]]'s Resonance Skill - [[Crimson Fragment]].'' ---- ===Forte Circuit=== '''Forte Circuits''' are unique to each character, both in ways to use and ways to increase (e.g. [[Danjin]]'s usage of her skill or [[Mortefi]] dealing DMG to increase his "Annoyance"). The usage of Forte Circuits is beneficial to combat all around, providing buffed output when used. ---- ===Resonance Liberation === '''Resonance Liberation''', used by clicking R, is a Forte that is released by using accumulated energy. They tend to be much more powerful than the Resonance Skills. ---- ===Intro/Outro Skills=== '''Intro''' and '''Outro Skills''' are Fortes that are used by switching characters after building a set amount of Concerto Energy. Resonators will do a joint attack after swapping with full Concerto Energy, dealing increased DMG, with the leaving character either giving a buff or dealing a massive amount of damage. *Changli's [[Strategy of Duality]] gives 20% Fusion DMG Bonus and 25% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus. ---- ===Concerto Energy=== '''Concerto Energy''' is increased by dealing damage to enemies. ---- ==Tutorials== {{Main|Tutorials}} There are '''11''' Tutorials related to Fortes and their use in [[Combat]] ====Resonance Liberation==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Resonance Liberation}} ====Outro Skill & Intro Skill==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Outro Skill & Intro Skill}} ====Dodge==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Dodge}} ====Counterattack==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Counterattack}} ====Counter Skill==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Counter Skill}} ====Aero Erosion Effect==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Aero Erosion Effect}} ====Electro Flare Effect==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Electro Flare Effect}} ====Glacio Chafe Effect==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Glacio Chafe Effect}} ====Fusion Burst Effect==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Fusion Burst Effect}} ====Spectro Frazzle Effect==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Spectro Frazzle Effect}} ====Havoc Bane Effect==== {{Transclude|Tutorial/Havoc Bane Effect}} ==See Also== *[[Combat]] *[[Weapons]] *[[Echoes]] ==Navigation== {{Combat Navbox}} {{Lore Navbox}}
